scope: Standalone candidate for six exact Time-1 Chronology identities; no shared integration or primary results

preconditions.chronology: Real ISO/Buddhist production factories; UTC or fixed +07:00 offset; explicit null means default ISO for constructors/retain. JVM default timezone pinned UTC and production UTCProvider selected explicitly. Named-zone/resource coverage is outside this candidate.
preconditions.method_receiver: Start with default Partial then seed hourOfDay=10, or year=2024 for getField. Assert receiver values and chronology before activating target tracing.
preconditions.getField: Protected target called from package-local probe on a real final Partial. Valid index 0; separate invalid index 1 boundary. Supplied Buddhist chronology must determine the field independently of receiver ISO chronology.
preconditions.public_array_constructor: Sorted year/month/day with independently specified leap-day values; separate invalid February 30 and year/dayOfMonth/era ordering rejection.
preconditions.internal_constructor: Package-private Chronology-first constructor skips validation and stores arrays directly. Use independently validated UTC fields/values; no claim of input cloning, arbitrary value validation or zone normalization for this signature.

assertions: Exact field types, named and indexed values, UTC normalization and concrete chronology class
Public array constructor protects stored values/types from input and getter-array mutation
Invalid hour/date/order rejected via exact constructor; bad index via exact getField
Buddhist year at epoch is 2513; exact supplied production year field and unchanged ISO receiver
Chronology-retain preserves hour 10, original receiver, new-object vs same-normalized-chronology identity, and null-to-ISO behavior
execution: Seal suite before execution; fixed twice, buggy twice; JDI trace on both unchanged production bytecodes; retain failed development attempts in separate immutable output paths
coverage: Exact JVM method-entry descriptors and source entry lines; no line/branch percentages
sensitivity: Temporary fixed getField mutation ignores supplied chronology; must fail Buddhist field/value assertion. Distinct from production bug detection.
limits: Bounded cases only; no full object equivalence, full domain coverage, owner approval, generation authorization or denominator change
